test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

A lot of social work is __hindered__ due to corrupt politicians.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 (Obstructed)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hindered"** means to create difficulties for someone or something, resulting in delay or obstruction. (बाधा डालना)

 
 
• **Example:** The heavy rain hindered the progress of the construction work.
 
 
 
• **"Obstructed"** means to block or get in the way of something, preventing it from progressing or continuing. (रोकना)
 
 
• **Example:** The fallen tree obstructed the road, making it impassable for vehicles.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of **'hindered'** is **'obstructed'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 (Obstructed)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Collided** (टकराना): To come into violent contact while moving.

 
 
• **Example:** The two cars collided at the intersection, causing a massive traffic jam.
 
 
 
• **Helped** (मदद करना): To assist or support someone in achieving something.
 
 
• **Example:** She helped her friend in completing the project on time.
 
 
 
• **Abided** (पालन करना): To accept or act in accordance with a rule, decision, or recommendation.
 
 
• **Example:** The citizens abided by the new regulations imposed by the government.
